name: Membership Inference Attacks Benchmark
description: A unified benchmark package for evaluating membership inference attacks (MIAs) on large language models trained on the Pile dataset. It includes all existing MIAs and supports large-scale evaluation across varying model sizes and domains.
typical_sota_score: 50–95% (highly dependent on model size, defenses, and attack configuration)
reputation: A newly proposed unified benchmark for membership inference on LLMs; useful for systematic comparison but not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Finds MIAs barely outperform random guessing in most settings; identifies conditions affecting vulnerability; releases code and data as a benchmark package.
